content: Nam7u Markkata
Hessafe guye ta izara wadha wadhdhanaas guufe misatiza shomboqoy taas imettides. Taas, «Neni dendada Xoossa Keeththazanne giddo kifileta wadhdha! Heen goynnizayta tayba.
Xoossa Keeththaafe karera coo dizasoza aggaaga; hessi Ayzaabetas imettidaso gidida gishshas ne iza wadhdhofa; ayzaabeti geeshsha katamayo oyddu tammanne nam7u agina gakkanaas yedhdhi haarana.
Ta markka nam7ati kayo may7o may7idi 1,260 gallas gakkanaas tinbite yootana mala ta isttas wolqqa immana» geetettides.
Heyti biitta Godaa sinththan eqqiza nam7u wogara miththatanne istta bolla xomppe woththiza nam7u ballata.
Oonikka istta qohanaas koykko istta doonappe tamay kezidi istta morkketa xuuggana; istta qohana koyzaadenti wuri hayqqanay hessa malankko.

Istti tinbite yootiza he gallassatan iray bukkontta mala salo gordanaas maatay isttas dees. Hessaththoka haaththata suuththan laammanaas koykkoka hara ay mala boshankka biitta shocanaas wolqqay isttas dees.
Istti ba markkateththaa wursidaappe guye hirki ciimma ollazappe keziza do7ay isttara olettidi istta xoonananne wodhana.
Istta ahay leemisora Sodoomenne Gibxe geetettiza gita katamayn coo demban zin7ana; hinna katamaya kase istta Goday izin kaqettidasoyo.
Dumma dumma qommotinne dumma dumma zarkketi, dumma dumma qaalan haasayzaytinne dereti heedzdzu gallassinne bagga gakkanaas istta ahaa xeellananne istta ahay moogettontta mala diggana.
Heyti nam7u nabeti kase biittaa bolla diza asaa waayisida gishshas ha7i qasse biitta bolla diza asay ha nabeti hayqqida gishshas ufayettana; he ufayssaas ba7aale ooththidi issoy issaas yes immana.
Gido attiin heedzdzu gallassinne baggay aadhdhidaappe guye isttas shemppo immiza peenoy Xoossa achchafe yiidi istta ahan gelides; isttika ba tohon eqqida; istta be7ida asay daro babbides.
Hessafe guye he nam7u nabeti, «Haa pude kezite!» giza qaala saloppe siyida; istta morkketi istta xeellishin istti shaarara pude salo kezida.

He saateyinka wolqqama biitta qaaththi handes; he katamaas tammaafe issi kushey laalettides; biitta qaaththaa gaason laappun shii derey hayqqides; hayqqontta attida asay gidikko daro babbidessinne salo Xoossaaka bonchchides.
Aayye ana! giza qaala nam7anththozi aadhdhiin heedzdzanththoza waasoy eeson gakkana.
Laappunththo Zaye
Laappunththo kiitanchchayka ba zayeza punnides; Salon, «Alame kawoteththi nu Godaa Xoossaassinne Kirstoosas gidides; izikka mernaappe mernaa gakkanaas kawotana» giza gita qaalay siyettides.
Xoossa sinththan ba alga alga bolla uttida nam7u tammanne oyddu cimatikka ba liiphen gufannidi Xoossaas goynnida.
Qasseka,

Salon diza Xoossa Keeththaa giddo kifiley doyettides; iza caaqo taabotazikka heen Xoossa keeththaas giddo kifilen beettides; wolqqanththi wolqqamides; giirissi giirides; daday dadattides; biitta qaaththinne wolqqama shachchi bukkides.
